segments.an10.119:1.1: Tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi [jānussoni (ka. sī.), jānussoṇi (ka. sī.), jāṇusoṇi (ka.)] brāhmaṇo tadahuposathe sīsaṃnhāto [sīsaṃnahāto (sī. pī.), sīsanhāto (syā.)] navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allakusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya bhagavato avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhito hoti.
segments.an10.119:2.1: Addasā kho bhagavā jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tadahuposathe sīsaṃnhātaṃ navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthaṃ allakusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ.
segments.an10.119:2.3: “kiṃ nu tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, tadahuposathe sīsaṃnhāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allakusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhito?
segments.an10.119:2.4: Kiṃ nvajja [kiṃ nu ajja (syā.), kiṃ nu kho ajja (pī.), kiṃ nu khvajja (ka.)] brāhmaṇakulassā”ti [brāhmaṇa brahmakusalassāti (ka.)]?
segments.an10.119:3.1: “Yathā kathaṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotī”ti?
segments.an10.119:3.2: “Idha, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā tadahuposathe sīsaṃnhātā navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthā allena gomayena pathaviṃ opuñjitvā haritehi kusehi pattharitvā [pavitthāretvā (ka.)] antarā ca velaṃ antarā ca agyāgāraṃ seyyaṃ kappenti.
segments.an10.119:3.3: Te taṃ rattiṃ tikkhattuṃ paccuṭṭhāya pañjalikā aggiṃ namassanti –
segments.an10.119:3.6: Tassā ca rattiyā accayena paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena brāhmaṇe santappenti.
segments.an10.119:3.7: Evaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
segments.an10.119:4.1: “Aññathā kho, brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hoti, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
segments.an10.119:4.2: “Yathā kathaṃ pana, bho gotama, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti?
segments.an10.119:4.3: Sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
segments.an10.119:5.1: “Tena hi, brāhmaṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an10.119:5.2: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.an10.119:6.2: ‘micchādiṭṭhiyā kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcā’ti.
segments.an10.119:7.1: … Micchāsaṅkappassa kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:8.1: … Micchāvācāya kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:9.1: … Micchākammantassa kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:10.1: … Micchāājīvassa kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:11.1: … Micchāvāyāmassa kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:12.1: … Micchāsatiyā kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:13.1: … Micchāsamādhissa kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:14.1: … Micchāñāṇassa kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
segments.an10.119:15.1: ‘Micchāvimuttiyā kho pāpako vipāko – diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcā’ti.
segments.an10.119:15.5: Evaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
segments.an10.119:16.1: “Aññathā, bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti.
segments.an10.119:16.2: Imissā ca, bho gotama, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇiyā brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
segments.an10.119:16.3: Abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Antarā ca velaṃ antarā ca agyāgāranti vālikārāsissa ca aggiagārassa ca antare.
